mapper.insert: INSERT INTO petcare.pago (reserva_id, monto, metodo_pago, estado_pago, referencia_transaccion, fecha_pago, comprobante_url) VALUES (#{reservaId}, #{monto}, #{metodoPago}, #{estadoPago}, #{referenciaTransaccion}, #{fechaPago}, #{comprobanteUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT pg.id, pg.reserva_id, pg.monto, pg.metodo_pago, pg.estado_pago, pg.referencia_transaccion, pg.fecha_pago, pg.comprobante_url, pg.created_at, pg.updated_at, pg.deleted, pg.version FROM petcare.pago pg WHERE pg.id = #{id} AND pg.deleted = FALSE

SELECT pg.id, pg.reserva_id, pg.monto, pg.metodo_pago, pg.estado_pago, pg.referencia_transaccion, pg.fecha_pago, pg.comprobante_url, pg.created_at, pg.updated_at, pg.deleted, pg.version FROM petcare.pago pg WHERE pg.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pg.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM petcare.pago pg WHERE pg.deleted = FALSE

mapper.update: UPDATE petcare.pago SET reserva_id = #{reservaId}, monto = #{monto}, metodo_pago = #{metodoPago}, estado_pago = #{estadoPago}, referencia_transaccion = #{referenciaTransaccion}, fecha_pago = #{fechaPago}, comprobante_url = #{comprobanteUrl}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
